name: 56304 · Saint Cloud, MN
findings: ZIP 56304 (Saint Cloud) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56304 (Saint Cloud) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56304 (Saint Cloud) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
